correctness.rationale: Source potential (107) fixed normalization 1/(2 pi beta), with a=2 beta. Derived F2 and F4 by angular moments and symbolically reconstructed F6; F4 = 3 K /(64 cosh(a)^4). Exact Maclaurin series K/a^3=128/3-sum_{n>=2}d_n a^(2n-2), with d_n>0 for every n>=2, proves precisely one root. Exact-rational certified interval gives 1.1429918<a*<1.1429919 and 3.2305076<F6<3.2306338; local Taylor and analytic monotonicity establish sextic min and fifth-root response, without global claims.
